text: If you're separated but not divorced, could your spouse still inherit from you? Here's a quick guide from RMO Law. In Queensland, separating doesn't change your legal relationship under the Succession Act. Until a divorce is finalised, the law treats you as married. If you die without a will, your separated spouse is first in line under the intestacy rules. Even with a will, they can still make a family provision claim. And jointly owned property, and super and life insurance nominations, may still pass to them. If you've separated, our team can help. Speak with RMO Law.
